Author: Grimmortal Dread
Name: No Quest Icons
Description: Removes the exclamation/question-mark and diamond icons above quest-giver nameplates, without touching target markers or hunt marks. Icons are auto-sorted by quest type (Main Scenario, Side Quest, Guildleve, Class/Job Quest, and more), with common types pre-categorized out of the box. Includes a peek key to reveal hidden icons on demand and a separate toggle key to switch the whole plugin on/off.
Punchline: Hides quest icons above NPCs, sorted by type, with peek and toggle hotkeys.
